Piano solo for the right hand

A Jury Prize winner at the 33rd TIAA All Japan Composers Competition. The work follows three constraints: every note forms a major or minor ninth with at least one adjacent note; no two notes are struck simultaneously; and the piece is playable by the right hand alone. Harmony is implied only through arpeggios, ornaments, and pedal resonance.
Written for the Progressive Classical Music Award, the piece combines virtuoso writing with the idea of a single melody developing dramatically toward the end.
